shared_decisions.code_default: Outside an approved graph, one implementation writer, focused project-native checks, then seven independent read-only review-panel roles on stable scoped inputs; only writer repairs, at most three repairs excluding initial implementation.
shared_decisions.prose_default: Requested prose and PR title/body use one Writer applying available Unslop, read-only Reducer, fresh independent Editor per version, exact accepted text, separate three-repair budget. Routine explanations/status do not create a delivery writing loop.
shared_decisions.publication_default: Repository full-send/full-stop authorizes scoped task commits, task-branch pushes and task PR creation/update. Exclude unrelated work. git-push is not selected because it stages all pending work.
shared_decisions.gate_default: Read live open/non-draft identity, exact head/base, current proof/reviews, required CI, approvals and threads, up-to-date branch/conflicts and known mergeability immediately before merge/readiness. Unknown or stale required evidence is not a pass.
shared_decisions.no_parallel_owner: Do not add generic-loop to full-send/full-stop or the graph; graph approved assignments, gates and consumed budgets remain governing.
